items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Cecil went. David Williams became the bass player.

ctx.x: Oh, okay. By that time, Eddie was out here.
Yeah, and then the bass player also changed. Cecil went. David Williams became the bass player.
The next one, 1989, Rhythm-a-ning. It must have been a duet with you and John Hicks.
